title: KLH Law School Portal
course: ADMINISTRATIVE LAW AND LAW ON PUBLIC OFFICERS
policies: Attendance shall be checked at the start of every session; students are expected to be punctual and prepared to recite on the assigned cases and topics.
Only the latest editions of the Constitution, the Administrative Code, and the assigned casebooks/reviewers may be used during recitation and examinations.
Cross-recitation and the Socratic method shall be used; students must be ready to answer questions on any case in the syllabus for the week.
No special examinations shall be given except for the most meritorious reasons, subject to the approval of the professor and the School of Law.
Use of Cellphone is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.
recitationNote: When called to recitation and absent will get 40 points, present and haven’t answer anything 60%.
consultation: By appointment, before or after class, or through the professor's official email or School of Law consultation schedule.

topics.title: General considerations
description: Nature; Origin, development, and current status
Sources: Constitution/Statutes (Article IX, 1987 Constitution; EO No. 292); Court Decisions; Rules/Regulations of Administrative Bodies; Determinations/Orders of Administrative Bodies
Administration
Distinguished from Law

topics.title: Administrative agencies
description: Definition; Nature; Creation and Abolition; Advantages; Relation to Regular Executive Departments; Control (by the President, Congress, Judiciary, and Ombudsman)

sections.title: A.  Control of Administrative Action
description: By the President (Control; Doctrine of Qualified Political Agency/Alter Ego Principle); By Congress; By the Judiciary; By the Ombudsman

topics.title: Powers of administrative agencies (general)
description: Quasi-Legislative/Rule-Making; Quasi-Judicial/Adjudicatory; Fact-Finding and Investigatory; Licensing; Rate-Fixing

sections.title: A.  Quasi-Legislative Power
description: In General; Doctrine of Delegation of Legislative Power; Requisites/Tests for Valid Delegation; Kinds of Rules

sections.title: B.  Quasi-Judicial Power
description: In General; Implements of Adjudicatory Power

topics.title: Administrative procedure
description: For Rule-Making; For Adjudication; Administrative Due Process; Administrative Appeal and Review; Administrative Res Judicata

topics.title: Administrative appeal, review, and res judicata

sections.title: A.  Kinds of Administrative Regulations (Interpretative; Legislative)
3.  Promulgated in Accordance with Prescribed Procedure

topics.title: Quasi-judicial power (detailed treatment) — administrative due process
description: Rules of Procedure; Subpoena Power; Contempt Power; Notice and Hearing
Administrative Due Process; Administrative Appeals and Review; Enforcement of Decisions; Res Judicata

topics.title: Judicial review
description: General Rule; Doctrine of Primary Jurisdiction; Doctrine of Exhaustion of Administrative Remedies; Doctrine of Finality of Administrative Action; Reviewable Questions (Fact vs. Law)

sections.title: B.  Doctrine of Exhaustion of Administrative Remedies
C.  Doctrine of Finality of Administrative Action

topics.title: General principles and the public officer
description: Public Office defined; Elements; Creation
Public Officer defined; Distinguished from the criminal-law concept; Distinguished from a clerk/employee

topics.title: Eligibility, qualification, and disqualification
description: Endowments/qualities/attributes; General Disqualifications (Secs. 6-7, Art. IX-B); Specific Disqualifications (multiple positions, e.g. Secs. 13, Art. VI & VII)

topics.title: De jure and de facto officers
description: Distinctions; Legal Effects of Acts; Remedies (Quo Warranto)

topics.title: Term and tenure; commencement of official relations — appointment
description: How commenced (appointment/election); Classification (permanent/temporary; regular/ad interim)
Steps in the appointing process; Discretion of the Appointing Authority; Judicial Review of Appointments
Jurisdiction of the CSC; Appointments to the Civil Service (career/non-career; exempt positions)

topics.title: Powers and duties; prohibitions
description: Authority (classification, doctrine of necessary implication); Ministerial and Discretionary duties
General and Specific Duties; Prohibitions (partisanship, double compensation, loans, nepotism, double office)

topics.title: Liability
description: General Rule; Statutory Liability; Liability on Contracts; Liability for Tort
Presidential Immunity; Threefold Liability Rule; Command Responsibility

topics.title: Rights; self-organization
description: Office (term/tenure); Salary (basis, preventive suspension, back salary, allowances); Preference in Promotion
Vacation and Sick Leave; Maternity/Paternity Leave; Retirement Pay; Self-Organization; Other benefits

topics.title: Accountability of public officers (the ombudsman and impeachment)
description: The Ombudsman: Appointment; Independence; Fiscal Autonomy; Qualifications; Powers, Functions, and Duties
The Special Prosecutor; Recovery of Ill-Gotten Wealth; Impeachment

topics.title: Personnel actions and disciplinary proceedings
description: Reinstatement; Principles of Discipline; Preventive Suspension

topics.title: Termination of official relations
description: Expiration of Term/Tenure; Hold-over Principle; Age Limit/Compulsory and Special Retirement
Resignation (form, courtesy resignation, voluntariness, acceptance, effectivity)
Recall (initiation, procedure, election, effectivity, limitations); Removal (security of tenure, grounds, procedure, jurisdiction); Judicial Review of Disciplinary Cases
